title: Freeing an Instructor a Snowsports School Household Asked For by Name
content:
An instructor the household asked for by name has to be freed for the new date, so a rebooking amount is added to a change of date on a Snowsports School booking. It is judged from the school's own request record and the instructor written on the booking.

Where a request for a named instructor stands against the booking with an outcome of confirmed and an instructor is written on the booking, the named instructor rebooking amount of 40.00 USD is added. Where a request for a named instructor stands against the booking with an outcome of confirmed and no instructor is written on the booking, the pending instructor rebooking amount of 15.00 USD is added. Where no confirmed request for a named instructor stands against the booking, no rebooking amount is added, and the amount stands at 0.00 USD.

## The two facts in combination

| Confirmed request for a named instructor standing against the booking | Instructor written on the booking | Rebooking amount added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 40.00 USD |
| yes | no | 15.00 USD |
| no | yes | 0.00 USD |
| no | no | 0.00 USD |

Only requests for a named instructor with an outcome of confirmed bear on the amount; a request standing with any other outcome leaves the booking in the last band.

## Cases in illustration

- A booking carrying a confirmed named-instructor request, against which an instructor has been written, carries 40.00 USD.
- The same booking with no instructor yet written on it carries 15.00 USD.
- A booking against which no confirmed named-instructor request stands carries nothing on this count, even where an instructor has been written on it.
